data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Shlomo, meaning 'peaceful' or 'peaceful god'. In the Old Testament, King Solomon is known for his wisdom and wealth. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
